Title: Why Hot Flashes Get Worse (3 Everyday Foods to Watch)

Description:
Face suddenly burning up mid-meeting, then drenched in sweat minutes later? Lower estrogen makes your body's heat control more sensitive - and coffee, wine, and spicy food can make hot flashes and night sweats hit harder.

Each one has a simple fix that doesn't mean giving it up for good - just a change in timing or amount.

Watch to find out why, and what to do instead.
